meta.name: On Call
meta.description:
Traci Harmon, a veteran female training officer, and her rookie male ride-along, Alex Diaz, navigate the loss of a fellow officer and politics of modern day policing  — in the department and on the streets of Long Beach.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: In the wake of tragedy, LBPD training officer Traci Harmon takes on new trainee, Alex Diaz who on day one is already learning the job is harder than he imagined.

videos.title: Laws of the Universe
videos.overview: A chaotic street takeover finds our officers grossly outnumbered, revealing philosophical rifts inside West Division.

videos.title: South of Heaven
videos.overview: Diaz learns that Harmon has enemies within West Division, and begins to fear she cannot be trusted.

videos.title: Unsung
videos.overview: Desperate for a lead, Harmon goes off book resulting in a major breakthrough and a deadly showdown.

videos.title: Not Your Savior
videos.overview: Back on patrol, the rift between Harmon and Diaz comes to a head.

videos.title: L.A. Woman
videos.overview: When Diaz's family is threatened, Harmon realizes she must break her own rules to fix it.

videos.title: War Machine
videos.overview: A shot caller's revenge mission results in West Division going head to head with an entire gang.

videos.title: How the West Was Won
videos.overview: Harmon and Diaz join forces with an elite squad to intercept a major drug shipment.
